Traffic Advisory:  National Day of Truth and Reconciliation

- Alderville First Nation
- Monday, September 30, 2025
- Arrive by 10:30 a.m.

To support the walk for the National Day of Truth and Reconciliation , please be advised of the following traffic arrangements:
- Parking: All attendees are asked to park at the Alderville First Nation Community Centre (8913 County Road 45) by 10:30 a.m.
- Shuttle Service: A shuttle will transport participants to the AFN Health Centre (8467 County Road 45), where the walk will begin at 11:00 a.m.
- Route: The walk will proceed northbound on County Road 45, turn onto 2nd Line, and conclude at the Community Centre.

Road Closures:
• County Road 45 at Roseneath Landing
• County Road 45 at 3rd Line

Diversions: Signs will be posted at County Road 18 – Minnetonka – 3rd Line Road.

#NthldOPP will participate and support in honoring this important day. ^jc

data.text:
Traffic Advisory for September 27, 2025

Traffic will be restricted on the Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (NH-44), provided the weather is fair and the road conditions are good.

Key points for commuters:

• Jammu to Srinagar: Light motor vehicles (LMVs) will be permitted to travel one-way from Jammu to Srinagar. Vehicles must pass through Nagrota (Jammu) between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM.

• Jammu to Doda, Kishtwar, and Ramban: LMVs heading to these districts from Jammu will also be allowed from Nagrota (Jammu) during the same 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM window.

• Mughal Road: The Mughal Road will be open for two-way traffic for LMVs, allowing travel from Srinagar to Jammu and vice versa.

Please plan your travel accordingly.
@traffic_jammu
